collect_env_info: collect and display the full detectron2 environment info including PyTorch, CUDA, compilers, and GPU details
collect_torch_env: collect and display the PyTorch environment information including version and build configuration
detect_compute_compatibility: detect GPU architecture compatibility of a compiled shared object file using cuobjdump
test_nccl_ops: test NCCL multi-GPU inter-process connectivity by spawning worker processes and running a distributed barrier
run_main: run the collect_env entry point to print environment info, test GPU tensor transfers, and optionally test NCCL
